breakdown.description: The apex point load is replaced by a finite pressure patch over the crown
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction, first mentioning a point load at the apex and then stating to replace it with a pressure patch. The ground truth resolves this by specifying the use of a concentrated point load. The generated specification correctly follows the ground truth by only including the instruction for a 'vertical point load of -5 kN is applied at the apex' and omitting any mention of the pressure patch.
